verdict.rationale: Alacritty ships its own official `alacritty` binary, installable via cargo. That binary includes an `alacritty msg` IPC subcommand that can script a running instance, for example `alacritty msg create-window`. This is a real first-party CLI surface, but the evidence shows only narrow window and IPC control, with nothing aimed at programmatic or agent-driven use. missing for 10: documented CLI command reference beyond create-window, machine-readable output or automation-oriented flags, agent/AI-oriented docs (llms.txt returns 404), independent corroboration of scripting the CLI.
